root_cause_summary: User (developer, same device as ELECTRON-3RA, Windows) reports: AionUi expects 'modelId' but Hermes sends 'id' -> 'missing field modelId'. CONFIRMED: 562 'skipped malformed list entry during deserialization: missing field modelId' warnings in logs (agent_client_protocol_schema::serde_util), firing right at Hermes $initialize response parse. Authority check: aioncore v0.1.52 depends on official crates.io agent-client-protocol 0.11.1 / schema 0.12.0, whose ModelInfo is serde camelCase with model_id -> wire field 'modelId'; NOTE the struct is marked **UNSTABLE** (feature unstable_session_model, 'not part of the spec yet, may change') - so this is Hermes non-conformance to the CURRENT schema rev of an unstable extension, an inherent version-skew risk. IMPACT CORRECTION (user's causal claim wrong): model entries being skipped did NOT break model selection - logs show session/set_model for xiaomi:mimo-v2.5-pro ACKed via legacy_model path and 9 models preloaded from agent metadata; the 'tool calls fail / terminal stuck' symptom has a DIFFERENT root cause visible in the same logs: Hermes's own bash resolution - 'HERMES_GIT_BASH_PATH=C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe fails to start; using C:\Windows\system32\bash.EXE instead' (= WSL bash) -> '/bin/bash: line 1: cd: /c/Users/.../hermes-temp-...: No such file or directory', one terminal tool ran 19980s (5.5h) before interrupt. Also same user filed ELECTRON-3RA (Hermes acp/stdio.py sys.stdout.buffer.flush() OSError Errno 22 right after $session/new -> process exit; Windows EINVAL-on-flush typically means the read end / pipe already closed; not yet root-caused, analysis interrupted by owner).
classification: third-party (Hermes) schema non-conformance + Hermes-side bash fallback bug; AionUi impact mostly cosmetic (562 noisy warnings, live model list from initialize empty but covered by metadata preload + legacy set_model)
diagnostic_gap: The tolerant serde skip logs the missing field but not WHICH agent/backend/payload kind produced it, nor a sample of the offending entry (id value) - attributing 562 warnings to Hermes required manual timeline correlation. Same warning also observed on claude backend (ELECTRON-3RD macOS logs) - source there unverified (possibly stale cached agent_metadata rows or another list kind); worth one labeled sample log.
next_action: 1) aionCore: plan ACP dependency upgrade (0.11.1/0.12.0 -> 2.0.0/1.6.0, dual v1/v2 schema) and migrate model selection fully to SessionConfigOption (value field), retiring the unstable session_model/ModelInfo path - this obsoletes the modelId-vs-id mismatch. 2) Report upstream to Hermes: their 'id' matches no official rev; ask them to follow current spec (config options) or at least modelId for legacy v1 peers; ALSO report their git-bash fallback picking C:\Windows\system32\bash.EXE (WSL) which is the real cause of the user's stuck terminals. 3) AionUi minor: label + rate-limit the skipped-malformed warning (562 repeats; also seen on claude backend, source unverified). 4) ELECTRON-3RA (stdout EINVAL) analysis interrupted - resume separately if prioritized.

evidence_inspected: logs.gz (covers 07-26/27; 562 missing-field warnings; hermes spawn/stderr; set_model acks; bash fallback warnings; 19980s stuck tool); db-diagnostics.json.gz + screenshot downloaded (not decisive for this case)
protocol_evolution_finding: Protocol HAS majorly upgraded and the verdict must be softened. crates.io timeline: aionCore v0.1.52 pins agent-client-protocol 0.11.1 / schema 0.12.0; upstream went 0.13.x -> 0.14 (06-18) -> 1.0.0 STABLE (06-24) -> 1.6.0 schema / 2.0.0 acp (07-21/23, latest). In latest schema 1.6.0 the UNSTABLE ModelInfo/session_model surface is REMOVED ENTIRELY (the 'may be removed at any point' warning came true); schema now ships dual v1/v2 protocol modules and model selection rides SessionConfigOption / SessionConfigSelectOption whose identifier field is 'value' (not modelId, not id). Implications: (a) Hermes's 'id' matches NO known official rev (0.12=modelId; 1.6=no ModelInfo) - still non-conformant, likely hand-rolled or following an older informal draft; (b) aionCore is ~2 generations behind (0.11/0.12 vs 1.6/2.0) on an extension that upstream deleted - the long-term fix is upgrading the ACP dep and moving model selection fully to config options (aionCore already partially does: logs show acp_config_option_set_requested config_id=model), which makes the modelId-vs-id fight moot; (c) the mismatch is best classified as version skew across an unstable-and-later-removed extension, not simple one-sided fault.
upstream_correction: Tier2 upstream research (2026-07-28): hermes-agent pins Python SDK agent-client-protocol==0.9.0 (import acp, use_unstable_protocol=True) and its source constructs ModelInfo with model_id= (serialized alias should be modelId); the bare 'id' field belongs to session MODES, not models - the user's 'Hermes uses id' claim is imprecise. Reconciliation with our observed 562 'missing field modelId' drops: most likely the Python SDK 0.9.0 serializes without camelCase alias (emitting model_id on the wire), which the Rust camelCase parser cannot find. Upstream fix suggestion adjusted: Hermes should upgrade the Python ACP lib (>=0.11) or serialize by_alias; note Python SDK is still 0.x overall, so Python-based agents lag schema evolution structurally.
